map.依据体重、运动时长、环境温度与运动强度，预测出汗量与脱水程度，给出科学补水节奏建: Based on body weight, exercise duration, ambient temperature and intensity, predict sweat loss and dehydration level and suggest a scientific hydration rhythm.
map.💡 预测模型：出汗率(L/h) = 0.8 × 强度系数 × 温度系数 × (体: 💡 Prediction model: sweat rate (L/h) = 0.8 × intensity factor × temperature factor × (weight/70); sweat loss = sweat rate × duration (h) × 1000; fluid intake is set at 125%-150% of the water lost
map.本工具为预测估算，实际出汗率因个体差异、湿度、风速、衣着与适应程度而不同，建议结: This tool is a predictive estimate; actual sweat rate varies with individual differences, humidity, wind speed, clothing and acclimatization, so calibrate it with pre-/post-exercise weighing
map.脱水率 ≥ 2% 即影响运动表现，≥ 3% 需警惕热损伤风险，≥ 5% 属重度脱: A dehydration rate >= 2% already impairs performance, >= 3% warrants vigilance for heat-injury risk, and >= 5% is severe dehydration requiring medical care
map.补水遵循\"少量多次\"，单次不宜超过 400mL，避免胃肠负担: Hydrate "little and often"; a single intake should not exceed 400 mL, to avoid gastrointestinal burden
map.运动超过 60 分钟或高温环境应补充电解质（钠、钾），不可只喝白水以防低钠血症: For exercise over 60 minutes or in high heat, replenish electrolytes (sodium, potassium); do not drink only plain water, to prevent hyponatremia
map.按体重丢失定补水量。: Setting fluid intake by body-weight loss.
map.马拉松补给站规划按出汗率换算每小时需补液体量，预防后半程脱水崩速。: When planning marathon aid stations, convert sweat rate into hourly fluid needs to prevent dehydration and a late-race pace collapse.
map.跑后轻 1 kg（≈失水 1 L）→ 补 1.2–1.5 L 含电解质液（少量多: 1 kg lighter after a run (~1 L water lost) -> drink 1.2-1.5 L of electrolyte fluid (little and often).
map.体重降 2% 即明显下滑，>3% 危险。: A 2% body-weight drop noticeably reduces performance; >3% is dangerous.
map.口渴滞后于实际缺水，长时间运动应按预估出汗率定时定量补，而非等口渴。: Thirst lags behind the actual fluid deficit; for long exercise, drink on a schedule and in set amounts based on estimated sweat rate rather than waiting for thirst.
map.运动补水策略估算工具，依据体重、运动时长、环境温度与运动强度，利用出汗率预测模型: A hydration strategy estimator: based on body weight, exercise duration, ambient temperature and intensity, it uses a sweat-rate prediction model to estimate total sweat loss, sweat rate (L/h), dehydration rate and body-weight loss, and gives a fluid-intake range at 125%-150% of water lost plus a staged hydration rhythm, helping endurance athletes and fitness enthusiasts manage fluid balance scientifically.

map.运动补水估算（出汗率经验模型，本页代码口径）：强度系数 intF = 低 0.6: Exercise hydration estimate (empirical sweat-rate model, page's actual logic): intensity factor intF = low 0.6 / moderate 1.0 / high 1.5; temperature factor tempF = 1 + (air temp − 20) × 0.035 (floor 0.4); weight factor = weight ÷ 70; sweat rate = 0.8 × intF × tempF × (weight ÷ 70) (L/h); sweat loss = sweat rate × duration (min) ÷ 60 × 1000 (mL); dehydration rate = sweat loss ÷ 1000 ÷ weight × 100 (%); body-mass loss = sweat loss ÷ 1000 (kg); rehydration range = sweat loss × 125%–150%, servings = max(1, round(duration ÷ 15)), fluid per serving = lower rehydration bound ÷ max(2, servings) capped at 400 mL per serving (over the cap, servings are recalculated at 400 mL). Validation: weight and duration must be >0 and temperature must be a valid number, otherwise the page prompts "Please fill in all valid values (weight and duration must be greater than 0)" and highlights the fields. Criteria: dehydration <2% normal, 2–3% mild (replace 125% of the loss within 2 h after exercise), 3–5% moderate (add electrolytes and replace 150% within 4 h), ≥5% severe and requiring medical attention; duration ≥60 min or temperature ≥28°C prompts sodium-containing electrolytes.
